cohort: 186 neonates diagnosed with respiratory distress presented to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), Mardan Medical Complex, Mardan from January 2022 to December 2022.
finding: The primary risk factors for respiratory distress in neonates were Cesarean section delivery and maternal infection.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as a key risk factor for respiratory distress, accounting for 38.7% of cases.
